inbodydescription.para: PLM needs to request UART0 and UART1, otherwise XilPM will turn it off when it is not used by other processor. During such scenario when PLM/other application tries to print debug message, system may not work properly.
PLM needs to request PMC IPI, else XilPM will reset IPI when it is not used by other processor. Because of that PLM hangs when it tires to communicate through IPI.
